en.name: Heart symbols
en.title: Heart Symbols: Copy and Paste Text Hearts (♡ ♥ ❤)
en.description: Copy and paste 14 heart symbols, from the thin outline ♡ to the solid ♥ and the pink emoji 💖. Tap a tile to copy, and see which hearts work in bios and chats.
en.lede: Tap a heart to copy it, then paste it into a bio, caption or message. The set runs from the thin outline ♡ to the heavy ❤ and the colored emoji 💖.

body.body: The outline heart ♡ and the solid heart ♥ are plain text characters, so they take the color and size of the text around them. The heavy heart ❤ is text too, but many phones draw it as a red emoji. The pink hearts at the end of the list are always emoji and keep their own colors. Choose a text heart when you want it to match your font, and an emoji when you want color.

Hearts from the Dingbats and Miscellaneous Symbols blocks show up in nearly every modern app, including Instagram bios, Discord names and Google Docs. Decorated hearts such as ❥ and ❧ come from older font sets, so a few devices show an empty box instead. If you see a box, switch to ♥.

en.alt: Three hearts drawn side by side: an outline heart, a solid heart and a double heart
faq: Why does ❤ turn red on my phone?
Phones draw the heavy heart as an emoji unless text style is requested. Add the invisible variation selector U+FE0E after it to ask for the plain text version, or use ♥, which always stays text.
Can I use these hearts in a username?
Most sites accept ♡ and ♥ in display names, but many block symbols in the handle itself. Check the field's rules before you rely on one.

zh.name: 爱心符号
zh.title: 爱心符号：复制粘贴文字爱心（♡ ♥ ❤）
zh.description: 一键复制 14 个爱心符号，从细线条的 ♡ 到实心的 ♥ 和粉色表情 💖。点击方块即可复制，并说明哪些爱心适合用在简介和聊天里。
zh.lede: 点一下爱心就能复制，粘贴到简介、配文或消息里。这一组从细线条的 ♡ 到粗重的 ❤，再到彩色的表情 💖。

body.body: 空心的 ♡ 和实心的 ♥ 是普通文字字符，会跟随周围文字的颜色和大小。粗重的 ❤ 也是文字，但很多手机会把它画成红色表情。列表末尾的粉色爱心始终是表情，自带颜色。想让爱心和字体保持一致，就选文字爱心；想要颜色，就选表情。

body.h2: 文字爱心在哪些地方可用
body.body: 来自装饰符号区和杂项符号区的爱心，几乎在所有现代应用里都能显示，包括 Instagram 简介、Discord 昵称和 Google 文档。像 ❥ 和 ❧ 这样的装饰爱心来自较老的字体，个别设备会显示成空方框，遇到方框时换成 ♥ 即可。

zh.alt: 并排的三个爱心：空心爱心、实心爱心和双层爱心
faq: 为什么 ❤ 在手机上会变红？
没有指定文字样式时，手机会把粗重爱心画成表情。在它后面加上不可见的变体选择符 U+FE0E 就能要求显示文字版本，也可以直接用始终保持文字样式的 ♥。
这些爱心能用在用户名里吗？
多数网站允许在昵称里使用 ♡ 和 ♥，但很多网站不允许账号名本身带符号。依赖某个符号之前，先看一下输入框的规则。
